name: Whitestone
author: Aziel Eliab
one_line: One ephemeral pro se advisor with Criminal, Civil, and Divorce practice areas, plus optional historical as-of evaluation (year/month) against a seeded federal timeline. Open the live Worker URL on a phone or desktop; optional software zip. Session-only memory; wipe on close. Uploads only, no case exports, no third-party LLM APIs. Labeled math, cited public statistics, AZCoherence-inspired anti-hallucination. Hosted app may fetch allowlisted public court/legal-aid pages for the session only.
coverage: High-level procedural overview and checklists for Criminal (bail/arraignment, discovery, plea, sentencing, expungement, rights), Civil (small claims, contracts, landlord-tenant, civil protection orders, name change, debt-collection defense), and Divorce/family (custody, support, dissolution, parentage, guardianship, family protection orders, adoption overview) — all 50 U.S. states and D.C. Optional historical as-of mode evaluates archival facts against a seeded federal constitutional and major-statute timeline with source URLs; state historical statutes are UNKNOWN unless a dated record exists.
disclaimer: Educational procedural guidance. Verify with the court clerk and counsel.
